    Settings

    Video quality

    What your own camera records and sends. Auto adapts to the room's size and your battery; a fixed choice pins it.

    Preview and frame what your camera would send on the stage. This does not put anyone on the stage.

    Your name

    What everyone sees on your tile: …

    Your picture, when the camera is off. An animated GIF stays animated.

    Captions language

    What your own device listens for when CC is on. It cannot guess: a phone set to Russian writes English down as nonsense, so pick the language you will speak.

    Admins only — every device starts writing down the voices it hears. Anyone can tap Captions to opt out.

    Sound mix Timing

    Share your screen

    Only this room’s admins — or people they allow — can share a screen. Ask an admin to allow you, on your tile or for the whole room, then open this again.

    A screen share is for what an app can’t be: a deck on your disk, a tool that isn’t GifOS, a window from somewhere else. It shows on the stage, so the whole room sees it — and everyone can see that it’s you sharing.

    Your camera pauses while you share, and comes back when you stop. Sound from the shared tab doesn’t travel — talk over it.

    Your screen share stopped when you came back.

    Run an app in this meeting

    Pick one of your apps. It runs live for everyone here — same state, same moves — with the meeting's audio, video and recording around it. Anyone can interact.

    Share this meeting

    Which meeting?

    This link reaches more than one live room. Pick the one you want to join — they are not merged, and you are not placed between both.

    We show people on the Stage when we can; if the stage is empty, the Stadium (everyone that room can see).

    Place a vote

    One vote each, while you are in the room. A majority acts.

    Room password

    Anyone in the meeting can set or change it — it reaches everyone here instantly, and new joiners must enter it. Leave empty to remove the lock.

    Banned devices:

    People

    There is no server in the middle storing this meeting. The phones and computers of the people in it are the servers: they connect straight to each other. That is also why everyone here can see everyone's internet address — nobody is anonymous. ✓ marks an address the GifOS relay verified or this device saw directly; anything else is only what that person's device reported. People who left stay on the list. To report illegal activity to law enforcement, download this list and include it.

    How this meeting works

    This meeting has no size limit. The dream: the whole Earth in one meeting at once — everyone able to speak. Your phone talks only to a handful of neighbors.

    The room

    • Stage — step up to be seen and heard first by the whole room. Tap again to step down.
    • Row — the people next to you.
    • The stadium — everyone else, one mosaic and one roar.

    Controls

    • Blur — how blurred your video looks. Only you control your camera.
    • Hand — join the queue.
    • Password — the key to clear video.
    • Invite — one link brings people in.
    • Run app — an app the room uses together.
    • Record / CC — record here, or captions from your voice.
    • Settings — mix for Stage, My row, and the stadium. Timing: Conversation, Unison, or Song.
    • Admin — a host can moderate. Most rooms stay open.

    Singing together

    Tap Song to lead. You step onto the stage as the song leader, and the room lines up so you are singing together, like a large hall.

    Keyboard shortcuts

    • Alt+A Mute or unmute
    • Alt+V Camera on or off
    • Alt+S Share or stop sharing
    • Alt+C Open or close chat
    • Alt+H Raise or lower your hand
    • Alt+F Fit everyone or scroll
    • F Open or close Full screen
    • Alt+Q Leave the meeting
    • Alt+W Who is here
    • Alt+I Invite
    • Alt+Y Run app
    • Alt+U Vote
    • Alt+L Password
    • Alt+G Stage
    • Alt+R Record
    • Alt+K Show or hide captions
    • Alt+, Settings
    • Alt+T Transcript
    • Alt+/ Help
    • Alt+M Mute or unmute every guest
    • Alt+B Blur or unblur every guest
    • Alt+X Turn every guest’s video off or on
    • Alt+P Let guests share their screen, or stop them
    • Esc Close a window or the chat
    • ? Show or hide this list
